author: Pallas, 1764
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 수확이 끝난 논밭, 습지 주변의 트인 수면
summary: 한강 하류, 김포평야, 서산 간월호, 금강 중류와 그 주변 농경지 등 몇몇 곳에서 해마다 수천 마리가 겨울을 나는 겨울철새로, 몸집이 큰 오리다. 아침과 저녁에 수확이 끝난 논밭처럼 비교적 마른 곳에서 무리 지어 풀줄기와 낟알을 먹고, 습지 주변의 트인 물에서 쉰다. 유라시아 대륙 중부에서 번식하고 북아프리카, 남아시아, 중국, 한국, 일본에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: contrasting white and black wings in flight

sexes.male: 번식기에는 목에 뚜렷한 검은 띠가 있고, 겨울에는 이 띠가 좁고 흐려진다.

art.subject: Ruddy Shelduck (Tadorna ferruginea), adult male in winter, as seen on Korean farmland from November to March: head and upper neck pale buff-orange, clearly paler than the body; a narrow, faint black collar around the lower neck; body plumage bright rusty orange; wing coverts white and flight feathers black, with a glossy green speculum, the white mostly hidden at rest; tail black. Bill black; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: foraging in a small flock in a harvested rice field
art.scene: Korean farmland in winter: harvested rice paddies and dry fields beside a wetland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view standing in a harvested field: bright orange body, paler buff-orange head, narrow black neck collar, black bill, tail and legs
adult female, head detail in side view: pale buff-orange head with a whitish face, no black collar, black bill
adult in flight, seen from above: orange body, large white forewing patches contrasting with black flight feathers, green speculum, black tail
art.build: Large, goose-like duck, 64cm, larger than a Mallard, with a rounded head, fairly short neck and longish legs giving an upright, goose-like stance when walking on fields. Bill black, short and broad, shorter than the head. Legs black. In flight broad-winged, showing striking white forewings (upper and under wing coverts) against black flight feathers, and a black tail.
avoid: Do not paint a red bill or a white body with a dark green head; that is Common Shelduck (Tadorna tadorna).
Do not give the head the same deep orange as the body; it is clearly paler.
Do not paint orange or pink legs; they are black.
Do not show a broad bold collar on the winter male; it is narrow and faint then.
